title: Static SASS feature vector
description: Closed-object schema for the per-kernel static SASS feature vector emitted by `workloads/simbench_bw/static_sass_features.py`. The output describes the BUILT cubin's static structural features: a per-mnemonic-family histogram (load/store, FP, integer, tensor-core, control, atomics) and the static register-usage record (regs_per_thread, register pressure indicators). All fields in this schema are CLAIMED ONLY AS STRUCTURAL SANITY CHECKS — they cannot carry an identifiability claim on their own per the closure plan's claim_class discipline. The downstream kernel feature vector (`kernel_feature_vector.schema.json`) composes a load-bearing dynamic axis (predication density) on top of this static feature vector to form the composite axis (5).

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel runner binary the cubin was extracted from.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical kernel-signature inputs. It matches nvbit_trace_summary.schema.json for the same kernel and, only during replay of retained pre-S4 evidence, the frozen CUPTI record validated by historical/cupti_activity_sidecar.v1.schema.json.

claim_scope.description: Cross-die claim-scope label per the closure plan's cross-die discipline.

mnemonic_histogram.description: Static SASS mnemonic family histogram. Composite-axis sub-field whose claim_class is `static_sanity_check_only`: it cannot serve as the SOLE evidence for an identifiability claim per the closure plan's claim discipline. A consumer that uses this sub-field as the only evidence emits a typed `claim_uses_sanity_check_axis_only` diagnostic and the claim is rejected.

register_usage.description: Static register-usage record. Composite-axis sub-field whose claim_class is `static_sanity_check_only`.

tool_provenance.description: Provenance of the SASS-extraction tool invocation that produced this record.

claim_class.description: Claim class for the entire static-features artifact. Frozen at `static_sanity_check_only` for every record this schema admits.

total_instruction_count.description: Total static instruction count across all family buckets. Must equal the sum of every family bucket's count.

families.description: Per-family static counts. Family taxonomy follows `references/NVIDIA_Manuals/cuda_binary_utility/04_instruction-set-reference.md` section on Blackwell mnemonic family categories.

count.description: Static instruction count attributed to this family.

exemplar_mnemonics.description: Up to 8 distinct mnemonic strings observed in this family bucket. Used for human-readable diagnostics, not for any quantitative claim.

regs_per_thread.description: Per-thread register usage as reported by the cubin metadata.

stack_frame_bytes.description: Static stack-frame size per thread, bytes.

spill_loads_static.description: Static count of spill-load instructions in the SASS dump.

spill_stores_static.description: Static count of spill-store instructions in the SASS dump.

extractor_name.description: SASS extractor identifier. Currently only the `cuobjdump --dump-sass` path is admissible.

extractor_version.description: Extractor version string (e.g. cuobjdump from a CUDA toolkit release).
